features.name: Totem Dragon
features.description:
Starting at 3rd level, choose which type of dragon you emulate. You can speak and read Draconic, and you are resistant to your chosen dragon's damage type.

| Dragon | Damage Type |
|---|---|
| Black or Copper | Acid |
| Blue or Bronze | Lightning |
| Brass, Gold, or Red | Fire |
| Green | Poison |
| Silver or White | Cold |

features.name: Wyrm Teeth
features.description: At 3rd level, your jaws become dragon-like while raging. As a bonus action, make a melee attack with your bite against a creature within 5 ft. You are proficient with the bite. On a hit: 1d8 + STR piercing damage + proficiency bonus in your totem dragon's damage type.

payload.name: Wyrm Teeth
payload.description: While raging: melee bite attack (1d8 + STR piercing + prof bonus in totem damage type) against a creature within 5 ft.

features.name: Legendary Might
features.description: Starting at 6th level, if you fail a saving throw, you can choose to succeed instead. 1/long rest. At 14th level, you can use this feature twice between long rests.

features.name: Aspect of the Dragon
features.description:
At 10th level, when you enter your rage, choose one aspect to manifest:

**Dragon Heart.** Gain temporary HP equal to 1d12 + barbarian level. 1/short or long rest.

**Dragon Hide.** AC increases by 2.

**Dragon Sight.** Blindsight 60 ft.

**Dragon Wings.** Fly speed 30 ft. Cannot manifest while wearing non-accommodating armor.

choices.name: Aspect of the Dragon
choices.description: Choose one draconic aspect to manifest when entering rage.

features.name: Wyrm Lungs
features.description: At 14th level, while raging, as an action, exhale a 60-foot cone breath weapon. Each creature in the area makes a DEX save (DC 8 + prof bonus + CON mod), taking 12d8 damage of your totem type on failure or half on success. 1/long rest.

payload.name: Wyrm Lungs
payload.description: While raging: 60-ft cone breath weapon. DEX save or 12d8 totem damage type (half on success).
